items.title: Suno Faces Another Copyright Suit from Universal Music and Sony Music Despite Its Recent Licensing Deals: ‘v6 Is Not a Fresh Start; It Is the Fruit of the Same Poisoned Tree’
items.summary: How many lawsuits is that now? Universal Music and Sony Music have fired off another complaint against Suno for allegedly training on an “enormous number of copyrighted sound recordings” without authorization. With their original Suno copyright suit still in motion, the non-Warner majors submitted the supersized infrin…

items.title: Suno Blasts Latest UMG/Sony Lawsuit As ‘Fundamentally Flawed on Both the Facts and the Law’
items.summary: UMG and Sony file another copyright lawsuit against Suno, and the AI company claps back with a statement that the suit is “fundamentally flawed.” Universal Music Group and Sony Music Entertainment continue to heat things up in their ongoing legal battle against the AI music platform Suno. items.title: Universal Music Sues DistroKid for Copyright Infringement and Deceptive Trade Practices, Says the Distributor ‘Is Flooding Platforms With AI-Generated Slop’

Outkast sue Ovrkast after he reneges on commitment to change performer name to something less confusingly similar
items.summary: Outkast have sued Ovrkast for trademark infringement. Rapper and producer Ovrkast admitted himself in a Rolling Stone interview last year that lots of people confuse the two artist brands. A company that manages Outkast’s trademarks says Ovrkast agreed to change his name by July, but then didn’t

items.title: AI-music startup Grai acquires social-music service Hangout
items.summary: In August we wrote about a startup called Grai becoming one of the first two companies – the other was Udio – to license a group of AI patents registered by UMG-backed Music IP Holdings. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Landmark termination rights ruling not the “copyright emergency” music publishers claim, songwriter tells US Supreme Court
items.summary: When America’s Fifth Circuit Appeals Court backed a songwriter-friendly interpretation of the termination right in US copyright law, the majors bought the song that prompted that ruling and asked the Supreme Court to intervene. The writer of that song has now urged the top court to not get involved

items.summary: In June the American Federation Of Musicians sued Universal and Warner over their AI deals, insisting the majors should be sharing their AI money with the union’s members under its Sound Recording Labor Agreement. Both sides have made new court filings as the majors try to get the lawsuit dismissed

tip.title: Guarda los proyectos, no solo el master
tip.body: En una disputa de autoría, el archivo de sesión de tu DAW con fecha, stems y versiones intermedias pesa más que el WAV final. Respalda el proyecto completo, no nada más el bounce.

tip.title: Keep the project files, not just the master
tip.body: In an authorship dispute, your dated DAW session with stems and work-in-progress versions carries more weight than the final WAV. Back up the whole project, not just the bounce.
